devdoc.author: Index Cooperative Oracle built to retrieve the assets per one share of the ERC-4626 vault
devdoc.details: WARNING: ERC-4626 vaults using this oracle must be evaluated for potential  read-only reentrancy vulnerabilities in the convertToAssets function. Vaults  found to have this vulnerability should not use this oracle.
devdoc.title: ERC4626Oracle

read().notice: Returns the assets per one share of the vault normalized to 18 decimals
